findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The triple sink in the preparation area and both bathroom sinks next to the fireplace area are observed to be in need of being re-sealed. Ensure that they are made to be smooth and easily cleanable. Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: There were raw, shelled eggs above a package of Macaroni and cheese and a container of milk in the bottom of a preparation cooler. CORRECTED- The PIC moved the eggs to the bottom shelf of the cooler. Ensure that food is protected from contamination during preparation, storage, holding, and display.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Compliance with variance/specialized process/HACCP.
findings.comment: The facility juices their orange juice themselves and bottles it. There is observed to not be a Consumer Advisory directly on the bottle. The label only states that the juice is unpasteurized. This was discussed with the PIC that juicing requirements are that if the juice is bottled, there needs to be a Consumer Advisory on the bottle. CORRECTED- The PIC made labels that included the Consumer Advisory and will place these on all future bottles. Ensure that all unpasteurized juice that is bottled includes a Consumer Advisory directly on the packaging.
findings.citation_text: 3-404.11(B) Treating Juice. Juice packaged in a food establishment shall be: (B) Labeled, if not treated to yield a 5-log reduction of the most resistant microorganism of public health significance: (1) As specified under § 3-602.11, and (2) As specified in 21 CFR 101.17(g) Food labeling, warning, notice, and safe handling statements, JUICES that have not been specifically processed to prevent, reduce, or eliminate the presence of pathogens with the following, “WARNING: This product has not been pasteurized and, therefore, may contain harmful bacteria that can cause serious illness in children, the elderly, and persons with weakened immune systems.”

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There was no soap observed to be at the handwashing sink in the kitchen by the cook line. CORRECTED- An employee replaced the soap and the PIC was educated to ensure that every handwashing sink is fully stocked with paper towels and soap to allow for proper handwashing. Ensure that all handwashing sinks are provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The sanitizer bucket by the front register was observed to be only be at 100ppm Quaternary ammonium. CORRECTED- The sanitizer bucket was remade and tested to be at 400ppm of Quaternary ammonium. Ensure that these are routinely tested and changed (every two to four hours is recommended) if not at the proper concentration of 200 to 400ppm of Quaternary ammonium.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.comment: Two of the employees along the cook line were observed to be bare hand touching ready-to-eat foods. CORRECTED- The manager immediately corrected this action and employees were educated to wear gloves. Ensure that all ready-to-eat foods are touched with either single-use gloves that are on WASHED hands or through a suitable utensil such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or dispensing equipment.
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There was a trash can observed to be in front of the handwashing sink on the cook line. CORRECTED- The manager moved the trash can to a position that does not block the handwashing sink. Ensure that handwashing sinks are maintained to be accessible at all times. Employees are more likely to wash their hands, and do it more frequently, if handwashing sinks are easily accessible.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: There is a leak coming from under the handwashing sink in the coffee bar area. Ensure that this leak is repaired. Wastewater should be disposed of properly.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.
